Number of studies.evidence_source: Between-Group Differences Item-level comparisons between men and women are summarized in Table 1. For each of the 10 items, a Bonferroni-corrected independent samples t-test was conducted (.05/10 = .005).

section_summary.extract_value: This section reports between-group comparisons (men vs. women) on BAS-2 item-level scores and the BAS-2 total score, noting several items and the total score were significantly higher in men while one item was higher in women. It also reports an ANOVA comparing BAS-2 means across universities; no multiple studies or study numbers (e.g., 'Study 1') are mentioned in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: Between-Group Differences Item-level comparisons between men and women are summarized in Table 1. The total score of the BAS-2 was significantly higher in men compared with women, t(1031) = 2.37, p = .021. The mean score of the BAS-2 was also compared across universities, F(6, 1025) = 0.69, p = .660.
